metaDescription: Shetland Sheepdog vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Shetland Sheepdog boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: The Shetland Sheepdog core series (DA2PP / DHPP plus rabies per law) is plotted at 8, 12, 16, 16 weeks in the table above so a small puppy is covered as maternal antibodies fade.
At 15-25 lb (7-11 kg), Shetland Sheepdog visit logistics matter as much as antigens: book the 16-week appointment before class, daycare, or boarding asks for proof.
Bring mdr1 drug sensitivity risk and collie eye anomaly risk into the Shetland Sheepdog exam-room conversation while you are already there for shots.
Rabies for a Shetland Sheepdog still follows local statute, and when the clinic allows you can pair it with the ≥16-week core finish, then photograph the certificate into PetClues the same day.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Shetland Sheepdog misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Shetland Sheepdog series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Shetland Sheepdog is the gap, not the embarrassment, because parvovirus pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated puppy even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up DA2PP / DHPP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Shetland Sheepdog away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Shetland Sheepdog due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Shetland Sheepdog core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Shetland Sheepdog misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Shetland Sheepdog health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Shetland Sheepdog adult health guide for breed predispositions such as mdr1 drug sensitivity risk, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
